title: Asset Purchase and Operations Transfer Agreement: Harrowgate Pines Care Center (99-bed skilled nursing facility)
fictional_notice: All parties and facts are invented.

defects.title: Closing 45 days after signing whether or not the Department has approved the buyer
defects.why: The closing is fixed for the 45th day after signing regardless of Department approval, and the change of ownership application is filed only within 15 business days after signing. No one may acquire or operate a skilled nursing facility before the Department approves and issues a license, and the application must be filed at least 120 calendar days before.
quotes: The Closing shall take place on February 26, 2027, being the forty-fifth (45th) day after the Effective Date, whether or not the Department has approved the CHOW Application or issued a license to Buyer as of that date.
Buyer shall prepare and file the CHOW Application with the Department within fifteen (15) Business Days after the Effective Date

defects.title: Interim management agreement gives buyer's affiliate operational control at signing
defects.why: The interim management agreement takes effect at signing and gives the buyer's affiliate exclusive control of operations, spending, direct-care staffing and admissions before licensure. Management agreements that transfer operational control or let another entity make financial decisions or direct staffing are covered by the prior-approval requirement.
quotes: Commencing on the Effective Date and continuing until the Department issues a license to Buyer, Manager shall have exclusive authority to direct the day-to-day operations of the Facility, including approval of all expenditures, the hiring, scheduling and assignment of nursing and other direct-care staff, and the admission and discharge of residents.

defects.title: Seller reports the change to the Department only 30 days before closing
defects.why: The seller's covenant is to notify the Department 30 days before the closing. The outgoing licensee must report the planned change 120 calendar days before the anticipated change and may not relinquish operations until the incoming applicant is approved.
quotes: Seller shall give written notice of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement to the Department not later than thirty (30) days prior to the Closing Date.

defects.title: Ownership disclosure limited to holders of 25 percent or more
defects.why: The ownership schedule identifies only holders of 25 percent or more and says smaller holders will not be named in the license application. Applicants must disclose every person with a beneficial ownership interest of 5 percent or more in the licensee or its management company.
quotes: This Schedule lists each Person holding, directly or indirectly, a beneficial ownership interest of twenty-five percent (25%) or more in Buyer or Manager. Holders of smaller interests are passive investors and have not been, and will not be, identified in the CHOW Application.

defects.title: All 128 facility employees terminated at closing on 10 days' notice
defects.why: The seller must terminate every employee at closing on as little as 10 days' notice, and the buyer has no obligation to rehire. The facility has had more than 75 employees for the past 12 months, so a mass layoff or termination requires 60 days' written notice.
quotes: Seller shall terminate the employment of all Facility Employees effective as of 11:59 p.m. on the Closing Date and shall deliver written notice of termination to each Facility Employee not later than ten (10) days prior to the Closing Date.

defects.title: Two-year noncompete required of administrator and director of nursing who own nothing
defects.why: The administrator and director of nursing are employees with no equity in the seller, yet must sign a two-year, 30-mile noncompete as a closing delivery. The sale-of-business exception covers only a person selling goodwill or an owner disposing of an ownership interest, so the covenant is void and unlawful to require.
quotes: each of the Administrator and the Director of Nursing, neither of whom holds any equity interest in Seller, shall agree not to be employed by or render services to any skilled nursing facility located within thirty (30) miles of the Facility for a period of two (2) years after the Closing Date

defects.title: Required admission agreement makes arbitration a condition of admission with a 3-day rescission window
defects.why: The admission agreement form that the buyer must use for 12 months after closing requires the resident to sign the arbitration agreement as a condition of admission and allows rescission for only three days. A facility may not make arbitration a condition of admission and must allow rescission within 30 calendar days of signing.
quotes: Resident agrees, as a condition of admission to the Facility, to sign the Resident-Facility Arbitration Agreement attached as Attachment 4. Resident may rescind the Arbitration Agreement by written notice delivered to the Administrator within three (3) days after signing.
